copy.heading: Final review
copy.instructions: Award yourself one point for each statement that is true. Lauren will check your answers, and Priya has already checked hers.

items: When Lauren asked "How was your day?" you answered with your day.
You have said "the fastest-growing sport in the world" less than once a week for a month.
The buggy is back in the boot.
You did bath time three nights a week for a month.
You gave your stand-up update without a padel stat.
You have not invited anyone new to padel in a month, including Graham.
You went to a family occasion in clothes that were not padel clothes.
You muted the group chat for a whole weekend.
You read this whole book without explaining a shot to anybody.
